reserveReview.rationale: Negative search 2026-09-04: the cNGN transparency page rendered metrics as of August 31, 2026, but those dated metrics cover trading and on-chain activity only; it provides no itemized reserve instruments, allocation weights, reserve balance total, or dated reserve examination. The page's aggregate 1:1 Naira/licensed-custodian-bank claim, WrappedCBDC's 1:1 Naira-deposit terms, and the ASC FAQ's partner-bank reserve description support the single 100% Naira bank-deposit category but do not establish a dated composition as of 2026-08-31. No dated reserve-attestation artifact or custodian-bank names were retrievable. The structured envelope therefore remains 100% Naira deposits with confidence probable and compositionAsOf 2026-07-31; it remains open rather than treating the August 31 activity date as a reserve-composition date.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The page does not identify the custodian banks, their allocation shares, account terms, or link a dated reserve examination report; the exact deposit liquidity is therefore unknown.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The 2026-07-31 re-opened issuer transparency, terms, and ASC FAQ identify only licensed/partner commercial banks and reserve accounts; they do not name active banks, disclose allocation shares, establish segregation or bankruptcy remoteness, state anti-rehypothecation terms, or document failure/replacement/successor-custody mechanics.
